∀ {A : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} {U : Type u_3} [inst : Ring.{u_1} A] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} V]
  [inst_2 : Module.{u_1, u_2} A V] [inst_3 : AddCommGroup.{u_3} U] [inst_4 : Module.{u_1, u_3} A U] {ι : Type u_4}
  [inst_5 : DecidableEq.{u_4 + 1} ι] (p : ι → Submodule.{u_1, u_2} A V),
  DirectSum.IsInternal.{u_4, u_2, u_2} p →
    (∀ (i : ι), IsSimpleModule.{u_1, u_2} A (Subtype.{u_2 + 1} fun x => Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} (p i) x)) →
      ∀ (f : LinearMap.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_3} (RingHom.id.{u_1} A) V U),
        Function.Surjective.{u_2 + 1, u_3 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1), u_2 + 1, u_3 + 1} f) →
          Exists.{u_4 + 1} fun J =>
            Exists.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1)} fun e =>
              ∀
                (x :
                  Subtype.{u_2 + 1} fun x =>
                    Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} (iSup.{u_2, u_4 + 1} fun i => iSup.{u_2, 0} fun h => p i) x),
                Eq.{u_3 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1), u_2 + 1, u_3 + 1} e x)
                  (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_2 + 1) (u_3 + 1), u_2 + 1, u_3 + 1} f (Subtype.val.{u_2 + 1} x))

source_text: Applying Lemma 3.1.6 to the quotient map V → V/W expresses V/W as a direct sum of a selected subfamily of the irreducible summands, equivalently as ⨁_X U_X ⊗ X.
